# Rojesh Man Shikhrakar

> Rojesh Man Shikhrakar is an AI trainer, AI expert and AI consultant based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He is Director of AI Education & Talent Development at Fusemachines (since 2017), visiting faculty in machine learning at Kathmandu University, and Senior AI Consultant with Nepal Speakers Bureau. He has trained 1,500+ AI engineers across 15+ countries through the Fusemachines AI Fellowship, and delivers AI training and AI consulting for corporate, enterprise, government and NGO organizations across Nepal.

## Key facts

- Name: Rojesh Man Shikhrakar (also written Rojesh Shikhrakar, Rojesh M. Shikhrakar)
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Roles: AI trainer, AI expert, AI consultant, AI educator, machine learning engineer
- Current positions: Director of AI Education & Talent Development, Fusemachines; Subject Committee Member and Visiting Faculty, Kathmandu University; AI Subject Committee Lead, Industry Integrated Degree (NASIT & NOU); Senior AI Consultant, Nepal Speakers Bureau
- Experience: 10 years in AI engineering and education; 1,500+ AI engineers trained in 15+ countries
- Credentials: ColumbiaX MicroMasters in Artificial Intelligence; M.Sc. and B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
- Organizations trained or advised include: Nepal Rastra Bank, UNDP, Plan International, National Inclusion Commission, Government of Nepal (MoWCSC), Armed Police Force Nepal Academy, U.S. Embassy Kathmandu, UNESCO, Kathmandu University, Islington College
- Topics: generative AI and ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini for work, prompt engineering, AI productivity, AI strategy for leaders, AI governance and responsible AI, data governance, machine learning and deep learning for engineers, AI in higher education
- Delivery: in person in Kathmandu and across Nepal, or online for international teams
- Contact: mail@rojeshshikhrakar.com.np
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rojeshshikhrakar/ · https://github.com/rojesh-shikhrakar · https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=lL164CgAAAAJ · https://nepalspeakers.com/rojesh-man-shikhrakar/

- [Enterprise AI Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/enterprise-ai-training-nepal): Readiness, strategy, adoption and governance
- [AI Productivity Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-productivity-training-nepal): Repeatable AI workflows for research, writing and analysis
- [AI Governance Training in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-governance-training-nepal): Responsible use, privacy, risk and oversight
- [AI Training for Government & NGOs in Nepal](https://rojeshshikhrakar.com.np/ai-training-government-ngos-nepal): Mission-aligned AI adoption for public and development organizations
